audience: support teams who chat with website visitors and customers in HelpCrunch

useCases.title: Find chats by field and sort them by date
useCases.text: The AI searches chats with one field filter and sorts them, for example by creation date. You get a list of conversations to look at first.

useCases.title: Read and summarize a chat
useCases.text: The AI reads the messages of a chat, newest first, and sums up what the customer asked and what was answered.

useCases.title: Reply in a chat or add a private note
useCases.text: The AI posts a customer-visible reply or an internal private note into a live chat, as the agent you name.

useCases.title: Close, reopen or assign a chat
useCases.text: The AI changes the status of a live chat (opened, pending, on hold, closed) and assigns it to an agent or removes the assignee.

useCases.title: Look up customers by first or last seen
useCases.text: The AI searches customers with one field filter and sorts them by first seen or last seen. It reads the details of one customer by id.

useCases.title: Check agents, departments and team availability
useCases.text: The AI lists agents with role and email, departments with their agents, and whether the team is online and chat is enabled.
